<description>
## Description

This PR allows `max-connections` to work with a bare `unix` address in `-ipcbind`.

Previously, `unix,max-connections=8` was rejected, while `unix:,max-connections=8` worked.

This change makes both formats valid and consistent, making the option easier to use and avoiding unnecessary configuration errors.

## Testing

- Added unit tests in `ipc_tests.cpp`. The tests pass with the fix and fail without it.
- Tested `-ipcbind=unix,max-connections=8` on regtest and confirmed that it creates 8 connection slots.

## Help text

The original help text now works as written, so the proposed help text change was removed.

Fixes #36657
</description>
